@feenberg Looking at the home heating credit tax form on line 47:
https://www.michigan.gov/taxes/-/media/Project/Websites/taxes/Forms/IIT/TY2024/MI-1040CR-7.pdf

The credit amount is multiplied by 52% (it was 56% in 2023) - I will update PE with the new rate as well.

To answer the other question, we have a boolean check for whether utilities are included in rent but we default it to false
